description: Deploy Puppet code for one environment via r10k — the console's on-demand poll (Core polls; PE deploys). Runs on the primary.

r10k_path.description: Path to r10k if not on PATH or in the puppet ruby bindir.

git_ssh_config.description: Optional per-run multi-host ssh_config content (Phase 47, D-10) staged to a temp dir on the primary for the duration of this deploy, then removed on every exit path (success, r10k failure, or process kill). Sensitive: carries no key material itself, but is unconditionally declared Sensitive to match the same discipline applied to git_ssh_keys below.

git_ssh_keys.description: Optional JSON object mapping sanitized host -> PEM private key content, staged alongside git_ssh_config for the duration of this deploy only.
